title: Fibonacci Modulo
prompt:
**Description:** Print F(n) modulo 10^9 + 7 where F(0) = 0, F(1) = 1.

**Input:** One line: n (0 <= n <= 100000).
**Output:** One integer — F(n) mod 10^9 + 7.

**Example:** `10` -> `55`.
